rows.en: Celica: "I never thought they'd target this place..."
Touya: "H-Hey! Who the hell are they?!"
Ymir: "Most likely the ≪Dawn of an Era≫.
They claim they'll revolutionize a corrupt society and create a new order,
and carry out acts of destruction in various places.
Rumor has it their leader changed,
and they'd been a little quieter lately..."
Celica: "Well, to put it simply, they're a terrorist group."
Touya: "!! Terrorists...?"
Celica: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "So it's the same in any world..."
Ymir: "..."
Ai: "Hey! Give me back my Vishal!
I finally got the hang of piloting it!"
Barkin: "Hmph! Nobody's stupid enough to hand it back
just because you ask, little girl."
Ai: "Ooh, you make me so mad!"
Barkin: "It's wasted as a child's toy.
We'll put it to good use."
Ai: "Use it? Oh! You're those terrorists, aren't you?!"
Barkin: "D-Don't call us terrorists!"
Ai: "...I knew it."
Barkin: "N-No! We have nothing to do with the ≪Dawn of an Era≫!
We're just passing mercenaries!"
Subordinate: "...That's a bit of a stretch."
Barkin: "Grr, shut up!"
Ai: "You must be desperate... Having to steal other people's things
just to build up your forces.
You're no different from a bunch of bandits.
Well, I guess those ideals of yours
don't amount to much after all.
Ugh, how pathetic. I'd hate to sink that low."
Barkin: "Grr! I've heard enough out of you!
I'll shut that smart mouth of yours right now!!"
Subordinate: "B-Barkin, sir, our objective is..."
Barkin: "Shut up! I won't back down
after being mocked by some little brat! Let's go!"
Ai: (All right! My plan worked.)
Touya: "That's... the robot from back then..."
Celica: "Huh? You know Zeifon?"
Touya: "So that's what it's called. Zeifon..."
Ai: "Aaaaaah..."
Touya: "Gah?!"
Ai: "Owww!"
Ai: "Oh... S-Sorry."
Touya: "Just like back then..."
Ai: "...Back then...?"
Touya: "Look after my bag."
Ai: "Huh? What?!"
Yamato: "Meow."
Touya: "Don't worry. I'll be right back!"
Ai: "Oh... H-Hey! Can you pilot it?!"
Touya: "I've done it before."
Ai: "Done it before? Where?!"
Touya: "In another world."
Ai: "Huh?!"
Barkin: "So Tyron won't come out after all.
...Then all that's left is that inexperienced one...
Heh heh heh. I'll teach that little brat a lesson!"
Subordinate: "Um... It looked like the Pilot changed just now..."
Barkin: "What?! That wasn't the deal!
Don't tell me it's Reduce?! How cowardly, changing without warning...
Grr, perhaps we should retreat..."
Subordinate: "But the movements look quite awkward.
Almost like a complete amateur."
Barkin: "...Hmph. As if I, the great Barkin,
could ever turn my back on an enemy! Let's go!"
Subordinate: "Y-Yes..."
Terrorist: "Barkin, sir! I've come to your aid!
Now that I'm here, you can rest easy!
Leave this to... Huh? Barkin?"
Subordinate: "...He's withdrawn."
Terrorist: "Wh-Whaaaaaat?!
Then why did I deliberately show up late...?"
Subordinate: "...Deliberately?"
Terrorist: "Oh! Ha, ha ha ha ha ha ha ha...
N-Nothing of the sort! I never once thought of arriving in a crisis
to make myself look good!"
Subordinate: "..."
Terrorist: "A-All right! In that case...
The power of the man they call the 'Boar of Agarthia'...
I'll show it to you!
Come on, weakling! My secret art, Wolf Pack Blood..."
Subordinate: "That's enough tall tales. I'll make sure
to report this to Barkin later."
Terrorist: "Huh? N-No, don't...
Another lecture... Barkin talks so long,
but never actually says anything..."
Subordinate: "...Shall I report that too?"
Terrorist: "A-All right! Here I gooo!"
Touya: "There's still more of them?!"
Ai: "That new guy looks kind of tough..."
Ymir: "Ai! This isn't the time for that!"
Ai: "Well, what do you want me to do...?
I can't move!"
Ymir: "Huh...? You've hurt your leg?!"
Ai: "...When I fell on that guy earlier..."
Touya: "...Huh? What's going on? They're still over there?!"
Render: "Wide open... Just like an amateur... Well, no matter."
Ai: "Aaaaaah!!"
Ymir: "Look out!"
Touya: "What?! I couldn't block it all?!"
Render: "...I see. Your companions are over there...
Trying to protect them has backfired."
Touya: "Y-You bastard..."
Render: "...Now you can't move..."
????: "So this is the real target.
A diversion, huh? A clever little trick.
But... you'll pay dearly for this."
Render: "Baldock... Clovis Camillion!"
Render: "Tch. At least I'll take out Zeifon... Hm?!"
????: "I won't let you do that."
Render: "Tch..."
????: "Now, what will you do?"
Render: "..."
Clovis: "Grr, jamming particles?! Not bad..."
????: "A very smooth withdrawal...
Those movements... A professional who's used to combat."
Clovis: "Yeah. Looks like he'll be trouble."

Bag request directed to Ai, Yamato only meows. Unknown boaster remains generic Terrorist: no unsupported mapping to Ioannis.
